question: In the flue gas of the hydrate-based CO2 capture simulation in the hydrate CCUS review, what share of the CO2 plus N2 feed, by mass, is CO2?
rendered:
According to Table 4 on page 7 of the document:

- CO2 0.19 44 7143 314
- N2 0.71 28 31,697 888

The total feed rate by mass is 314 + 888 = 1202 kg/h (or 1202 g/s).

The mass fraction of CO2 in the feed is 314 g/s / 1202 g/s = 0.262 or 26.2%.

So, the share of the CO2 plus N2 feed, by mass, that is CO2 is 26.2%.
